mergeRequests.title: Merge requests
mergeRequests.subtitle: Every collected merge request with its sprint, team, size and phase times.
mergeRequests.bigHint: Big merge request: counts with this weight in the reviewer ranking
mergeRequests.fromCalendar: Sprint from the sprint calendar (not in the branch name)

sprints.title: Sprints
sprints.subtitle: Number of merge requests per sprint and team (from the branch name, else the sprint calendar).
sprints.hint: Teams and sprints come from the branch name pattern (Settings).

reviewers.title: Reviewer ranking
reviewers.subtitle: Reviews done (approval or change request), weighted by size: a merge request with {{files}}+ changed files counts {{weight}}.
reviewers.hint: Each merge request counts once per reviewer; the author never counts.
reviewers.empty: No reviews in the selected merge requests.

assign.title: Reviewer assignment
assign.subtitle: Give the open merge requests of a team's sprint that have no reviewer to the developer lowest on the ranking board.
assign.disabled: Assigning writes to GitLab and is not enabled for this deployment (features.reviewerAssignment with the api scope). The plan below is a preview.
assign.noScope: Your sign-in has no api scope, so GitLab will refuse the assignment. Sign in with a token or OAuth application that has the api scope.
assign.membersFailed: The members of some data sources could not be read; people seen in the merge requests are still listed.
assign.choose: Choose a team and a sprint.
assign.none: Every open merge request of this team and sprint already has a reviewer.
assign.noPool: {{count}} merge request(s) need a reviewer: choose developers for the pool.
assign.author: Author

outcomes.skipped: Skipped (has a reviewer now or is not open)

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Sprint and team detection and review weighting. Saved in this browser; download the file to keep or share it.
settings.resetDone: The deployment defaults are in use again.

settings.sprintsHint: Used when the branch name has no sprint: the merge request belongs to the sprint whose dates contain its creation day.
